messages:
Ethan Park: change freeze is on and we have an enterprise private upgrade tomorrowwhat's the complete go/no-go gate we need to cite in the ticket?
Grace O'Connor: Need GO recorded at window start: error budget/SLO review link (or explicit risk acceptance), alerts routed to active oncall, rollback plan + decision point, and no overlapping high-risk changes.
Naomi Feldman: If the upgrade touches auth/RBAC/audit/TLS or introduces new images/deps, security sign-off must be recorded before GO.
Laura Bennett: CS has to approve the customer maintenance notice before it goes out + customer must confirm whos present for smoke tests.
deploy-bot: FYI freeze exception requires director approval + link in the change record.
